subject.title: feat(ui): context usage ring, thinking stream, and live tool cards

question: Should the Control UI expose live reasoning independently of the session reasoning-level setting and combine that policy change with context and live tool-card UX in one PR?
rationale: The branch changes user-visible reasoning policy as well as presentation, while its two required backend contracts are still unmerged; repository evidence supplied here does not show prior maintainer approval for that combined direction.

options.title: Split and sequence the work
options.body: Approve the backend contracts separately, then narrow this PR to UI rendering with an explicit decision on reasoning visibility.

options.title: Sponsor the bundled UX port
options.body: Approve the combined context, reasoning, tool-progress, and confirmation-dialog experience as one coordinated Control UI release.

options.title: Defer live reasoning exposure
options.body: Keep the context and tool-card work but remove live reasoning until its privacy and visibility policy is decided.

recommendation.title: Split and sequence the work
recommendation.body: Approve the backend contracts separately, then narrow this PR to UI rendering with an explicit decision on reasoning visibility.

likelyOwner.reason: Low-confidence routing candidate for a Control UI product-direction decision; exact current-main ownership should be confirmed with file history.
